summary: This directory centralizes the application's foundational domain models, shared business rules, and complexity analysis logic, providing a unified structure for calculating system metrics and maintaining consistent data entities across the codebase.
responsibilities: Define core domain entities and shared data structures
Calculate and aggregate structural and logical complexity metrics
Enforce consistent business logic and interface contracts
Compute complexity scores for code symbols and effect signals
relationships: Domain entities provide the data structures that complexity metrics analyze.
Shared interfaces ensure that business logic and complexity calculations maintain consistent data representation.
Complexity metrics use core domain models to derive quantitative scores for code components.
designDecisions: Separation of data structures from implementation logic
